completed.summary: The static head made four false claims. Removed the fabricated aggregateRating (4.9 from 150 - LEGAL-002 removed the same fabrication from the runtime provider and missed this copy, the one crawlers read). Generated the 1200x630 og-image.png that og:image and twitter:image had pointed at since launch without either file existing. Repointed the Organization JSON-LD logo from the 404 /logo.png to /logos/logo.png and corrected its declared 512x512 to the real 2000x600. Dropped the SearchAction offering a sitelinks box at /search, which is not a route, and the msapplication-config pointing at a browserconfig.xml that does not exist. Separately, favicon.svg used React's stopColor instead of SVG's stop-color, so both gradients fell back to black - verified in Chromium, rgba(0,0,0,255) before, rgba(67,100,237,255) after. New guard: npm run check:seo-assets, CI-wired, zero-tolerance.
